purpose: Teach: コンビネーション/クズ/適格/供与/にあたり/勲章/公聴/意匠

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 色のコンビネーションを社内デザインで統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's standardize the color combinations across our in-house designs.
lines.style: Gentle but organized opening proposal, soft attack, steadying into quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。クズ鉄、つまりクズ材の処理業者を選定します
lines.en: Right. For the scrap iron — the scrap material, I mean — I'll pick out a disposal contractor.
lines.style: Easy agreeable pickup with a small self-correction, half-smile carrying in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 適格者リストを作成しましょう
lines.en: Let's draw up a list of qualified candidates.
lines.style: Brief, tidy suggestion, politeness rising slightly at the end, pen already moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引先への試供品の供与計画を立てます
lines.en: Sure. I'll put together a plan for providing samples to our clients.
lines.style: Relaxed, competent confirmation, ticking the item off with a trace of late-week fatigue.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 案件着手にあたり、関係者と顔合わせしましょう
lines.en: Before we launch the project, let's have a proper meet-and-greet with everyone involved.
lines.style: Careful, considerate phrasing, gentle emphasis on bringing people together, warmth surfacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員勲章授与式の名簿を整えます
lines.en: Got it. I'll get the roster ready for the employee decoration ceremony.
lines.style: A wry little lift on the grand ceremony name, then a smooth businesslike close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地方議会の公聴会に弊社の意見を伝えましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our company's views are heard at the local assembly's public hearing.
lines.style: Quietly resolute, a touch more formal, small breath taken before the important item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の意匠登録を急ぎます
lines.en: Right. I'll fast-track the design registration for the new product.
lines.style: Crisp closing beat, energy lifting slightly, end-of-meeting relief creeping in.
